newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market rate down 20 bps to 10.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market rate down 20 bps to 10.1 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate eased to 10.1 percent on Thursday from 10.3 percent in balanced trade.
Dealers put total settlements lower at 30.8 million kuna, of which 26.8 million was fresh borrowing. Most of this consisted of call money loans granted at an unchanged 9.0 percent.
The end of trading left no kuna surplus.
Insurers rolled over previous loans at an unchanged 9.0 percent. An old 11-day interbank loan was prolonged at 10.0 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Friday slightly weaker at 5.4939 against the dollar and firmer at 3.5226 against the German mark.
